content:
Aisha: handing off to @Jin — I'm primary until 18:00 UTC. Kendall is our secondary until 02:00 UTC then Nina covers overnight if swapped. Quick summary below.

Aisha: what happened (short):
- 09:39 UTC: sudden spike in 429/throttled responses from /v1/embeddings in prod-eu-west.
- 09:41 UTC: autoscaler scaled the dedicated-embeddings pool down to 2 pods due to a misapplied HPA override.
- 09:43 UTC: clients started seeing elevated latency and queued requests, 429s peaked at 11% for a 12-minute window.

oncall-bot: ALERT: elevated-429-rate on service embeddings-prod-eu-west — 429 rate 11% at 09:40 UTC, paging rotation aisha, kendall. Incident: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2027-001

Aisha: immediate mitigations we executed:
1) pinned minReplicas on the HPA to 6: `kubectl patch hpa embeddings-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}' -n inference-eu`
2) scaled the pool up manually: `kubectl scale deploy/embeddings-pool --replicas=8 -n inference-eu`
3) rolled back the recent autoscale policy change that introduced aggressive scale-down.
4) temporarily lowered per-pod concurrency in the proxy config to reduce head-of-line blocking.
Result: 429 rate dropped below 1.5% by 09:58 UTC and p95 latency returned to baseline by ~10:05.

Aisha: runbook used: /runbooks/serving/embeddings-rate-limit.md — key checkpoints: verify hpa events on controller-manager, check lb queue depth on proxy-eu-*, scale or pin HPA, revert autoscale policy, and open INF ticket.

infra-ops: noted that the override was merged yesterday by a bot policy change; ops will look into why the deploy pipeline didn't flag the override.

Jin: acked. pls paste the exact commands and any kube events you grabbed so I can reproduce in the postmortem. Also I'll take ownership of INF-410 and INF-411 (follow-ups).

Aisha: commands/events we captured:
```
# hpa event tail
kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=embeddings-hpa -n inference-eu --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 20
# patch minReplicas
kubectl patch hpa embeddings-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}' -n inference-eu
# manual scale fallback
kubectl scale deploy/embeddings-pool --replicas=8 -n inference-eu
# check pod logs for 429s
kubectl logs -l app=embeddings-pool -n inference-eu --since=30m
```

Aisha: tickets I created: INF-410 "embeddings HPA override caused production throttling" assigned to @Jin and @infra-ops, includes timeline and histograms. OPS-901 "pipeline: allowlist hpa override changes" assigned to infra-ops pipeline team for a fix. Links: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-410 and https://redwood.internal/tickets/OPS-901

Nina: FYI I have limited availability 01:00-04:30 UTC tomorrow. I can be on pager for urgent incidents but won't be able to join bridges. There's a coverage hole for the 02:00-03:30 window unless someone swaps.

Kendall: I can take the 02:00-03:30 overnight slot if needed. @Nina please confirm and I'll update the schedule.

Aisha: thanks Kendall. Please also watch for any post-incident pages about queued backpressure — the proxy LB has a known issue where queued requests can burst when pods come back up. Dashboards to check: `embeddings.proxy/queue-depth`, `hpa/desired_replicas`, `ingress/5xx_rate`. Quick prom query: `sum(rate(embeddings_throttle_total[5m])) by (zone)`

oncall-bot: NOTE: Postmortem template instantiated for INC-2027-001 and linked to INF-410. Please set severity and customer impact score.

Aisha: customer impact: realtime customers in eu-west experienced increased 429s and retries; estimated affected customers ~12 (top producers) for ~26 minutes. CS notified with an interim message. No billing anomalies detected.

Jin: action items I'm taking:
- Jin: own RCA and flesh out root cause hypothesis in INF-410 (due EOD).
- Jin: coordinate with pipeline infra on OPS-901 and confirm if bot policy should require manual review (due 3 days).
- Kendall: validate that the HPA alert thresholds include decreases as well as scale-ups (due next day).
- Aisha: add a runbook note about defensive minReplicas and add a sub-check to the embeddings runbook (due 48h).

Aisha: added an infra snippet to INF-410 with the kube events and logs. Also added a small dashboard widget: `dash/embeddings/429-overview`.

Kendall: added to my calendar to check the overlayed HPA metrics first thing in my overnight hour. Will post here if anything else pops up.

infra-ops: we'll investigate why the pipeline allowed the HPA override without a canary gate. OPS-901 created to track the pipeline hardening.

Jin: scheduling a 30-min retro for Wed 11:00 UTC with eng-sre + infra + serving. I'll send invites and include INF-410 as pre-read.

Aisha: last note: if any pages come in while I'm finishing handover, please @Jin immediate, @Kendall secondary. I'll be online for another 20m for context.

Kendall: got it.

Nina: thanks everyone, confirming swap with Kendall for 02:00-03:30. I've updated OPS-901 comment with availability notes.

Jin: closing the loop: p95/p99 back to baseline, queue-depth normalized. INF-410 updated with mitigation timeline and pending action items. Marking handoff complete from my side once I post the RCA draft.

Aisha: thanks team, good handoff.

end of thread
